title: Introducing the Dock
summary: Chat is just one app. The Dock brings together Chats, Files, Mail, Messages, Calendar, and an App Store in one place: a new harness for knowledge work.
body_markdown:
## What It Is


Chat is just one app. The Dock brings together Chats, Files, Mail, Messages, Calendar, and an App Store in one rail at the bottom of every desktop.


## How It Works


Open anything from the Dock and it tiles into the task you are working on. The V opens Start: the built-in apps, the apps and agents your firm has published, and a place to build your own. Pin the ones you use most.


## Getting Started


A new harness for knowledge work, available today in the Vesence web app.[Book a demo](https://www.vesence.com/demo) or[request an invite](https://www.vesence.com/request-invite) .
